description: This source file defines a FastAPI application demonstrating dependency injection using 'Depends' and retrieval of query parameters and cookies.

methods.name: query_extractor(q: str | None = None)
methods.description: Extracts a query string parameter from the request, returning None if not provided.

methods.name: query_or_cookie_extractor( q: Annotated[str, Depends(query_extractor)], last_query: Annotated[str | None, Cookie()] = None, )
methods.description: Retrieves the query parameter or cookie value, prioritizing the query parameter if present.

methods.name: read_query( query_or_default: Annotated[str, Depends(query_or_cookie_extractor)], )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/items/', returns the combined query or cookie value.
